rules.description: Whether data is encrypted at rest (yes/no) must align between canonical and row
rules.messageTemplate: At-rest encryption stance contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Align encryption-at-rest claims with the canonical data-protection statement.

rules.description: Row should reflect a similar share of scope language from the canonical encryption scope
rules.messageTemplate: Encryption scope answer omits major themes present in the canonical scope description
rules.resolutionGuidance: Include the same data categories and storage locations described in the canonical answer.

rules.description: Stated at-rest algorithm family must match between canonical and row when both specify an algorithm
rules.messageTemplate: Encryption algorithm in the row does not match the canonical specification
rules.resolutionGuidance: Use the same algorithm and key-size language as the approved canonical answer.

rules.description: When canonical specifies KMS/HSM or envelope encryption, the row should mention key management
rules.messageTemplate: Canonical describes managed keys but the row does not mention key management
rules.resolutionGuidance: Describe KMS/HSM or envelope encryption consistently with the canonical answer.
